name: Winterfall Runners exist on Kalimdor before anyone visits their spawn
contract: Winterfall Runner (10916) waypoint spawns 42250-42252 start at 6886,-4085 and walk an 8241-yard loop through Winterspring. They are in the world as soon as Kalimdor exists, so a player who waits on the path without ever coming near the spawn point still has all three runners on the map.

steps.label: three Winterfall Runners loaded on Kalimdor
